description: Record an action you will take or took, with the signal you expect back (POST /actions). Always send a commitmentKey (a short stable id for the objective, e.g. 'acme/quote-followup') and expectedSignalAt. A second open commitment with the same key is refused 409 COMMITMENT_ALREADY_OPEN and the body returns the open one: that is how you resume. A look-alike is refused 409 POSSIBLE_DUPLICATE: resend with confirm_new true only if it is a different objective.

commitmentKey.description: Stable id of the objective this commitment serves (recommended)

description.description: What the action is, in one sentence

dueAt.description: When the action itself is due; without it the action never becomes overdue

expectedSignal.description: What you expect to see if it worked, e.g. 'Dana replies with a date'

expectedSignalAt.description: When the expected signal should have arrived

expectedSignalSource.description: Where the expected signal will appear

detail.description: Where exactly to look, e.g. the thread subject

projectId.description: UUID of an existing project in this workspace

roi.description: What it is worth, each dimension 0-5. Optional; never inferred by Forbiz

name: forbiz_commit
title: Record a commitment
